Prevention: Deep ploughing to destroy infected straw from the previous season
Change variety, when previous season’s plants were infected by disease
Use of resistant variety (Bg 366, Bg 359, Bg 352)
Use proper seed rate for long grain rice:
Add partially burned paddy husk to the soil
Split application of nitrogen fertilizer (based on leaf colour charts)
Weed control to remove alternates host plants
Monitoring: Regular visits and observation of the rice plants
Observe diamond shape lesion on the leaves
Observe alternative host plants for symptoms
Monitor for weather conditions, such as high humidity, that favour blast development
If infection on the leaves is more than 10%, go for chemical control
Restrictions: U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use); Maximum two applications
Application intervals 10- 14 days; 2-4g /kg seed; WHO Class
